verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents Warehouse Connectors to sync data from Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, and Postgres directly into Mixpanel, plus a Raw Event Export API for continuous export of events out to external systems including data warehouses. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of warehouse connector reliability and no explicit doc on querying warehouse tables in-place (federated query) without ingestion.
